events.name: Speed friending
events.description:
Forget swiping, forget hovering by the bar hoping someone talks first — Speed Friending is where Azúcar plays matchmaker for your friend group. Rosie and Michael take the mic and the reins, running mini games built to smash through small talk fast and get you laughing with strangers before you even catch their name.

Prizes are on the line, walls are coming down, and every rotation is a chance to meet someone already woven into our community — or someone brand new to it. No pressure, no pretending, just real conversations sparked by games that force the fun.

The Main Floor turns into one big icebreaker on November 7th at 9pm. Come solo, come with your person, leave with a whole new crew. This is community-building, Azúcar-style — loud, warm, a little chaotic, and exactly how real friendships start.

🗓️ Sábado 7 de noviembre — Show 9:00 PM
📍 Azúcar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🔞 21+ · Cover Free

🎟️ Tickets: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/speed-friending-tickets-2004390139865

events.name: Freaketonas
events.description:
Fridays just got a new name. Freaketonas is Azúcar's new weekly night, every Friday from 9pm to close, with DJ Ralphy-Ray running the room on perreo, dembow, house and Latin hits. Vibras latinas start to finish: the kind of night where you come out, dance until they turn the lights on, and leave with your voice gone.

Drink specials all night: Mexican candy cocktails, tequila cocktails, and spiked horchata for the ones who know. Plus the full food menu if you need something to keep you going.

No cover. 21+. Doors at 9pm.

Azúcar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA 99301.
